optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Model Evaluation Engineer, Enterprise Knowledge Base

professionalSummary.text: Maintains evaluation sets of question-answer pairs with source passages and scoring scripts for a knowledge base product.
professionalSummary.witness: Maintained the evaluation sets of question-answer pairs with source passages (around 1,900 items across four content domains) and the scoring scripts that compute answer correctness and citation accuracy.

professionalSummary.text: Runs pre-release evaluations for model versions and publishes reports with domain breakdowns to relevant teams.
professionalSummary.witness: Ran the pre-release evaluation for each of the five model versions released in the year and published the report with per-domain breakdowns to the model team and the head of product.

professionalSummary.text: Coordinates evaluation-set changes with model and content teams during quality reviews.
professionalSummary.witness: Coordinated evaluation-set changes with the model team and the content team in the fortnightly quality review; ship or hold decisions for each version were taken by the head of product on the basis of the report and the model team's recommendation.

professionalSummary.text: Documents evaluation assumptions, limitations, and hand-over conditions for each version.
professionalSummary.witness: Wrote the evaluation notes for each version, listing set composition, the known limitation that newly added content domains were under-sampled, and the hand-over items for the next evaluation.
